greens.grass: TifEagle bermudagrass, overseeded with Poa trivialis for THE PLAYERS (regrassed from MiniVerde in the 2016 renovation)
greens.typical_stimp: About 13 for THE PLAYERS (reported for 2025); daily-play speed not published
greens.notes: Greens are mowed at 0.100 in. for the tournament (S6, S18). Speed figure from S11. Grass history from S6 and S7. The 17th green is 3,912 sq ft (S8), smaller than the course average.

boundaries.ob_summary: No course-wide OB map or OB local rule was found; the scorecard prints none. The only documented OB is an internal OB left of the 18th-hole lake, added by the PGA TOUR for the 2021 PLAYERS (S12) and not confirmed for later years.
boundaries.penalty_area_summary: 18 water hazards (lakes and lagoons), with water in play on 17 holes per the 2026 fact sheet. The official hole descriptions (S4) put water on Nos. 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18. Water around the 17th island green is about 4 ft deep (S9). These are penalty areas, not OB.

gaps: Elevation: no per-hole tee-to-green figure is published anywhere searched. The only number is the course-wide range of 16-22 ft above sea level (S5), so change_ft is null on every hole. Raised greens (Nos. 3, 6) and mounding (Nos. 4, 14, 18) are described in words only.

Out of bounds: no hole-by-hole OB information (property lines, homes, roads) was found, and the scorecard prints no OB local rule. out_of_bounds.present is null on Nos. 1-17. The 18th-hole internal OB is documented only for the 2021 PLAYERS.

Green size: only the 17th green's area (3,912 sq ft) is published; the other 17 are null. Width is published only for No. 17 (81 ft). Average green size is 5,500 sq ft (2021, 2023 and 2026 fact sheets); an older Golf Channel piece says 4,500 sq ft average and 4,000 sq ft for No. 17.

Green depth: taken from the 'Depth =' value on each hole page of TPC's 2025 yardage guide (S2). The guide prints no unit or label; yards is inferred because No. 17's value of 26 equals the published 78-ft depth (S8) and No. 3's 30 matches '30 yards deep' in hole guides. Confidence is medium.

17th green depth conflict: 78 ft (Golf News Net 2026; TPC guide 26 yds) vs 68 ft (NBC Sports 2024). 78 ft is used. The pot bunker is placed on the right by the official guide (S4) but front-left by Golf News Net (S8).
Green slope: no slope or tier description was found for Nos. 1, 2, 11, 15, 17 and 18.
Green speed: the tournament speed (~13) is from Golf Monthly (S11), not an official PGA TOUR figure. Daily-play speed was not found.

Yardage conflict: TPC's July 2025 yardage guide (S2) prints a different 'THE PLAYERS' tee column (423/532/177/384/471/393/451/237/602/424/558/369/181/481/470/523/141/462 = 7,279, essentially the pre-2025 tournament set). It also gives No. 15 as 396 yards (not 366) for the B&W Blended, White and W&G Blended tees, making those totals 6,426, 6,116 and 5,539. The scorecard PDF (S1) is used here; both documents add up internally. GolfPass (S17) matches the scorecard. All tee totals in this file sum correctly.
Scorecard edition: the scorecard PDF has no printed date or edition; the 2025 date comes from its upload path on tpc.com.

Course rating: the women's ratings on the card are labelled 'Ladies' White', 'Ladies' Blended' and 'Ladies' Green'. 'Ladies' Blended' is mapped to W&G Blended (5,509 yds) because GolfPass gives that pairing. Wikipedia lists an older 7,245-yd / 76.4 / 155 rating. No USGA NCRDB page could be checked directly.

Penalty areas: the 2026 fact sheet says water is in play on 17 holes. The official hole descriptions mention water on only 14 holes, with none on Nos. 3, 5, 8 or 10. Hazard placement is from the theplayers.com descriptions, which still list 2024 yardages; layout changes since then are tee moves only (S13).
Hole names: the Stadium Course has no official hole names. 'Island Green' for No. 17 is a nickname, so every name is null.

Grass labels: PGA TOUR course stats list 'Overseeded Bermudagrass' (2026) and 'Tifsport Bermudagrass' for greens (2024). The TifEagle base comes from S6/S7; the 2024 PGA TOUR label looks like a template error.
Schema fit: the card gives separate women's handicaps. handicap holds the men's value; the women's value is in each hole's notes.
